title: Path traversal — user-controlled path joined to UPLOAD_DIR with no containment check
description: The route uses the `<path:filename>` converter, allowing `filename` to contain `/` and `..` segments. os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename) resolves outside the uploads directory without containment checks; any authenticated user can read arbitrary files (secrets, source, keys) at web process privileges via paths like `../../etc/passwd` or `../../.env`.
